assets.scientificFinding: NCBI retains Mollicutes as current class NCBITaxon:31969 within Mycoplasmatota. The class is phylogenetically broader than a single wall-less shape and includes walled relatives, so this plate shows only selected wall-less descendant forms. LPSN records a typification caveat. Primary structural evidence supports pleomorphic rounded forms and selected Spiroplasma-like helical geometry. The treatment is representative, non-exhaustive, non-universal, and non-diagnostic.
assets.visualReview: Exactly nine bodies appear in seven separated spatial groupings: five isolated singles and two touching two-body pairs. The singles comprise one oblong oval, one near-spherical body, one mildly lobed irregular body, one larger oval, and one short smooth helical tube. Counts and groupings match the prompt. Every subject has its own ordinary boundary and is fully visible on a uniform cool pale field. No appendage, spore, capsule, halo, shared envelope, biofilm, text, label, scale bar, host material, scene, clipping, signature, or watermark is visible.

assets.scientificFinding: NCBI Taxonomy and current fungal nomenclature records retain Mortierella as genus NCBITaxon:4855 and Index Fungorum/MycoBank record 20345, with Mortierella polycephala as type species. Current primary morphology supports mainly coenocytic, irregularly septate hyphae and simple or branched tapering sporangiophores with globose terminal sporangia. The treatment is type-species anchored, representative, non-universal, and non-diagnostic.
assets.visualReview: One connected hyphal specimen grouping supports exactly three upright main sporangiophores and three globose terminal sporangial heads. The left upright is unbranched; the center and right uprights each show two short empty upper side branches. Each head visibly contains many tightly packed round spore-like internal units, with no released spore cloud. Numerous transverse hyphal bands are visible rather than only occasional subtle septum lines, a literal output deviation that requires Control Tower review. The specimen remains within the full frame but extends beyond the standard centered cover-crop band, so a future social derivative would require contain. No text, label, scale bar, substrate, plant, host material, scene, clipping, signature, or watermark is visible.
